operational_restrictions: Do not publish this unsigned predraft as an accepted audit.
Pin before device/model initialization and GPU work; use m2_route::open for the audited entry path.
Retain one executor owner with no overlapping device/stream work, including initialization and work submitted outside this module.
No other callers may mutate Candle GEMM precision controls. The three stores and reads are separate operations, not a transactional policy update.
Checks are snapshots and cannot detect every transient unauthorized change, including flip-and-restore between checks.
Retain MathModePin for the complete execution lifetime. After detected drift, poisoning or operational failure, restart the process rather than reacquiring a guard to continue.
Require profile F, BF16 model storage, physical sequence B=1 and nonempty sequences bounded by engine.max_len<=1024. Do not treat logical request cardinality as physical batch size.
Prohibit external mutation of cuBLAS handle pointer mode, math mode, stream or other configuration during executor use; the audited helpers pass host alpha/beta pointers.
Validate the audit identity through the acceptance driver before passing it to m2_route::open; MathModePin itself checks only that the string is nonempty.
Keep mapped model files immutable and deploy the model directory read-only.

Do not substitute plain GEMM, cuBLASLt, quantized GEMM, fused attention or replacement custom kernels without a new audit and acceptance run. The existing SoftmaxLastDim custom-op route is explicitly included.

Bind the final artifact to the full repository revision, Cargo.lock, preserved feature tree and every examined source-file hash. Confirm Candle uses cudarc 0.19.10 in the audited enabled graph; the orphan 0.17.8 lockfile entry is not the audited dependency.
Revalidate after dependency, feature, model-call-site, layout, CUDA/cuBLAS, driver or device changes.
Keep source-audit evidence separate from runtime numerical acceptance, determinism and bit-identity evidence. COMPUTE_32F and DEFAULT_TENSOR_OP do not identify a fixed internal cuBLAS algorithm.
